title: A sprint worker can restore a tracked file of its touches that it damaged in its own worktree
goal: A headless worker that damages a tracked file inside its touches (ST-s4cihfge truncated _tools/test_redact.py to 0 bytes with a failed open-for-write) restores it to HEAD by a permitted command, instead of stopping with the work uncommitted because git checkout and a cp from git show are both denied (SP-7nv2ffr2 close).
notes: Triage 2026-10-16: its check names a test the pruned suite (D-6kei5o2z) lacks; no planted check yet: Restore command unnamed: git restore/checkout are not allowed or denied in .claude/settings.json (operator-only), backlog.py has no restore. Design choice, nothing to drive.
